full_model_note: heart_full_tuned.pkl (11 features, deployed threshold 0.3695) cannot be evaluated on the Tehran/Z-Alizadeh Sani cohort directly -- 4 of its 11 features (MaxHR, Oldpeak, ST_Slope, ExerciseAngina) are UNAVAILABLE in that dataset, documented in evaluation_evidence/heart/external_validation.json's feature-mapping table. This figure is the best available external-validation approximation for the tuned model family, measured on the 7-feature reduced variant that Tehran's data can actually populate -- not a direct measurement of the 11-feature model that is actually shipped to production.
note: Supersedes the external_validation.json figure from omnidiag_heart_kaggle, which used heart_reduced.pkl (pre-tuning). Both the old and new figures are for the reduced (7-feature) model -- the model family evaluable on Tehran -- not the full 11-feature model.
